resources.string: Save map areas on this device · %1$d saved
Give each world its own spoken wording and delivery on your device\'s speech voice. Turn it off for standard instructions.
Show the posted limit and warn when you go over it while driving. Looks up the limit on OpenStreetMap through Overpass, sending your position only while guiding by car.
Google search suggestions, details and photos

Optional keyless Google web lookups. Google receives partial search text and a location bias while you type, then the selected place name and coordinates when you open its details. These undocumented endpoints can change and are subject to Google’s terms; no Places API key or Places API billing is used.

Show Vela open-data pins while browsing. Vela matches archive names on-device; GitHub gets nearby tile ranges, not search text. With Google off, searches start after 700 ms; on a saved-snapshot miss, Photon gets text and location bias, and Android Geocoder may be used for weak matches. Google gets partial text and location bias only when suggestions are on. This switch hides pins only.
Tilt the map in every world
When off, follow your phone heading while still and travel direction while moving.
These presets affect controls floating over the phone map.
Choose a model included with Waypoint. Phone map only; Android Auto keeps its standard marker.
No 3D models are included in this version.
